svg.title: TabICL v2 - classifier
svg.desc: soda-inria - column set transformer -> row encoder -> in-context stack · 27.6 M parameters. Symbols in shapes: B: ensemble members (batch); n: rows in the context (train + test); p: raw features; F: feature groups; E: embedding width; n_test: test rows (the rows being predicted). Abbreviations: ICL: in-context learning: test rows attend to the labelled training rows; CLS: learned summary token that reads out a row or column; RoPE: rotary position embedding; MLP: multilayer perceptron (the feed-forward sublayer); GELU: Gaussian error linear unit (activation); LayerNorm: layer normalisation; KV: keys and values (as in KV cache, KV heads). How to read: each table: training rows above, test rows below, columns across; attention across rows, within a column; the arrow points from the test rows to the training rows they read; attention across columns or features, within a row; inducing points: a small learned set that summarises the rows; outlined cells: an embedding, where every cell becomes a vector; the prediction for the test rows; one wide column: after this point the table's columns are merged into one vector per row; × N: the block is stacked N times; over rows / columns / features: the axis this block's attention runs across; right columns: the tensor shape each stage emits, then its exact parameter count.
svg.text: soda-inria - column set transformer -> row encoder -> in-context stack · 27.6 M parameters
numeric matrix; the wrapper imputes first
Linear(3 -> 128) over a column and its 2 neighbours; the 4 CLS slots pass
added on the labelled rows, so a column's summary is target-aware
induced self-attention: 128 learned inducing points attend to the labelled
4 learned columns overwrite the reserved slots
RoPE over the column order; 8 heads; the last block queries from the CLS
added on the labelled rows at the flattened width 512
pre-norm; 8 heads of 64; keys and values are the labelled rows only; scalable
10 slots; softmax over the classes seen
in-context learning: test rows attend to the labelled
learned summary token that reads out a row or column
keys and values (as in KV cache, KV heads)
